meta.title: Vendor declines an event with a reason
gaps: Click the vendor's "I don't wish to participate" button, select a non-participation reason, and confirm with "I will not participate".
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Click the vendor's "I don't wish to participate" button, select a non-participation reason, and confirm with "I will not participate".

steps.note: Create the live event needed by the setup.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Use an RFQ event matching the setup.
Invite the QA vendor required by the setup.
Publish the event so the vendor can access it.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Land on the vendor's Event Overview screen specified by the case.

args.need: on the vendor Event Overview, click "I don't wish to participate", select a non-participation reason, and confirm with "I will not participate"

steps.note: The catalog has no vendor-decline action or reason selector.

args.text: You've decided to not participate, Want to change your response?

steps.note: Verify the expected non-participation confirmation is displayed at the bottom of the vendor screen.
